The '''New Republic Army''' was a segment of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]] that served as the ground military of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It was formed from the [[Alliance Army/Legends|ground forces]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after the New Republic was established.

==History==
Formed from the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance Army]], the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rebel SpecForces]] were re-purposed as [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] to seize bridgeheads during [[Planetary assault tactics|planetary assaults]], while the bulk of the Army was to be used for occupation and peacekeeping duties.

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the Army won a protracted three-month [[Milagro campaign|battle on Milagro]] against the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] the army [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberated]] Coruscant under the command of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], General [[Rand Talor]], and General [[Brenn Tantor]].

The New Republic Army suffered heavy losses fighting against the [[Dark Empire]] in [[Operation Shadow Hand]]. Following the post-[[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] reorganization of the New Republic Defense Force, the Army was abolished and its defense responsibilities transferred to the [[Planetary Security Forces]], while the [[New Republic Marine]]s took over the planetary assault role under the command of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|naval]] [[Battle group/Legends|battle groups]] as part of a fully-integrated Defense Force.

After the formation of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], the Army was reformed as the [[Galactic Alliance Army]].

==Vehicles <nowiki/>==
Comprising of [[Rebel combat speeder|combat speeders]], [[Rebel attack tank|attack tanks]], [[T1-B hovertank]]s, [[T3-B heavy attack tank]]s, [[Hover Transport TC9]]s, [[Mobile Proton Torpedo Launcher]]s, [[Tracked Mobile Base]]s, [[Scanner Jammer]]s, and [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]].

==Troop variants==
The common infantry was the [[New Republic soldier/Legends|New Republic trooper]]. Other variants included [[Missile Trooper (Rebel)|Missile Troopers]], which specialized in missile launchers and demolition expertise. [[Scout Soldier]]s, used for protecting worlds and quelling riots. [[Sea Commando]]s, elite commandos trained in aquatic warfare. [[Thermal detonator trooper (Rebel Alliance)|Mortar Troopers]], specializing in providing cover fire, acting as support units.

[[New Republic Marine]]s, specializing in massive, planetary assaults. Used exclusively by [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]].

[[New Republic Honor Guard]]s, tasked with the protection of the [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]]. [[Palace Guard (New Republic)|Palace Guards]], are to ensure security within the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]].

[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Protectors]], ally forces often helping the New Republic. Assisted in the [[Battle of Mindor|Battle of]] [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]].

==Weaponry==
[[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A280 blaster rifles]], [[DH-17 blaster rifle/Legends|DH-17 blaster rifles]], [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistols]], [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistols]], [['aKraB clip-point vibrodagger/Legends|AKraB vibrodaggers]], [[Mortar/Legends|mortars]], [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]], [[blast cannon]]s. Explosives included [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], [[7-PrG proton grenade/Legends|7-PrG proton grenades]], [[C-16 fragmentation grenade]]s.
